Concierge Dentistry for Palm Harbor Families

Clearwater Dentist, led by Dr. Nadia Pokrovskaya, D.M.D., provides Palm Harbor residents with comprehensive dentistry in a calm, modern, and welcoming setting. Whether you need a routine cleaning, a full smile makeover, or same-day relief from a dental emergency, our team blends clinical excellence with a genuinely gentle, patient-first approach.

We are easy to reach from Ozona, Crystal Beach, and the East Lake area, with convenient parking and flexible scheduling that fits busy Palm Harbor families.

Services We Offer Palm Harbor Patients

  • General & Preventive Dentistry
  • Cosmetic Dentistry
  • Dental Implants
  • Porcelain Veneers
  • Invisalign Clear Aligners
  • Teeth Whitening

  • Sedation Dentistry

Anxiety-Free, Therapy-Dog-Friendly Care

Dental anxiety keeps many people from the care they deserve. For our Palm Harbor neighbors, we offer sedation options and our beloved dental therapy dog program to make every visit calm and comfortable.

Palm Harbor Dentist FAQs

Do you accept new dental patients from Palm Harbor, FL?

Yes. Clearwater Dentist happily welcomes new patients from Palm Harbor and throughout the Tampa Bay area. You can request an appointment online or call (727) 285-8132.

How far is your office from Palm Harbor?

Our office at 1700 N McMullen Booth Rd, Ste A1, Clearwater, FL 33759 is a short, convenient drive from Palm Harbor, including Ozona, Crystal Beach, and the East Lake area.

I'm anxious about the dentist. Can you help Palm Harbor patients feel comfortable?

Absolutely. We offer gentle, judgment-free care, sedation options, and our signature dental therapy dog program to help nervous patients from Palm Harbor relax during their visit.

What dental services do you offer Palm Harbor residents?

We provide comprehensive care for Palm Harbor families — from cleanings and fillings to dental implants, Invisalign, veneers, teeth whitening, and emergency dentistry.

Concierge family & cosmetic dentistry with an artistic touch — serving Clearwater, FL and the greater Tampa Bay area.
